## Frequently Asked Questions
### What does Exterprise do?
Exterprise is a ServiceNow Premier Partner for consulting and implementation and a smartsourcing (business process outsourcing) company. We implement and support ServiceNow, including AI Agents and Now Assist, and run business processes such as contact center, records processing and data capture for clients in the US and around the world.
### Is Exterprise a ServiceNow partner?
Yes. Exterprise is a ServiceNow Premier Partner for Consulting & Implementation and a licensed ServiceNow reseller, with a team of ServiceNow-accredited professionals and Now Assist certifications for IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery and Creator.
### Where is Exterprise located?
Exterprise is headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with offshore delivery centers in Chennai and Coimbatore, India, and a near-shore center in San Pedro Sula, Honduras. More than 500 professionals work across these locations, so work can run around the clock.
### Which industries does Exterprise work with?
Exterprise works with county governments, nonprofits and enterprises in government, oil and gas, retail and real estate, delivering ServiceNow, outsourcing and custom technology solutions.
### What solutions does Exterprise offer?
Exterprise offers three solutions: ServOps, for service operations excellence on ServiceNow (servops.com); UtterNow, which lets people run ServiceNow workflows by voice (utternow.ai); and Omnitix, omni-channel contact center solutions with multilingual, 24/7 support across voice, email, text and chat (omnitix.us).
### How do I start a project with Exterprise?
Email contact@exterprise.us or send a message from the Contact page. A consultant or ServiceNow architect will review your goals and suggest the right next step, whether that is an assessment, an implementation plan or a dedicated team.
## Let's Talk!
Tell us what you’re working on, whether that’s ServiceNow, AI or running a business process, and we’ll point you to the right team.

## Extend Your Enterprise, With Exterprise
Exterprise was founded in 2015 by Prabhu [PK] Karunakaran with one goal: help US-based organizations run more efficiently and cost-effectively by extending their operations and service delivery to teams in India and Central America.
That idea, extending your enterprise, gave us our name and our tagline. We opened our main offshore delivery center in Chennai, India, with a small team, and have grown to over 500 professionals, globally.
Today we combine offshore and near-shore delivery with ServiceNow, enterprise and technical expertise, always designed to reduce cost, increase efficiency and stay compliant.
## Accuracy & Efficiency
Built on new ways of doing business.
### x7 Round-the-Clock Processing
Multi-shift operations deliver service around the clock to help you meet your SLAs.
### 99.99% Adherence to SLAs
A business model built to maximize efficiency and accuracy.
### FTE / Hourly / Per Unit
Flexible pricing, including FTE-based, hourly, fixed project fee and per-unit transactional, so budgets are transparent.

# ServiceNow
Enterprise service management, AI Agents, and Now Assist. Designed, deployed, and governed by a ServiceNow Premier Partner for Consulting & Implementation.
ServiceNow Solutions & ServicesTalk to Us
Advisory, implementation, integration, migration, and ongoing support, covering everything from core ITSM and CSM to AI Agents and Now Assist.
## ServiceNow Solutions & Services
We design, build, integrate, and support ServiceNow from start to finish, from core ITSM and CSM to AI Agents and Now Assist.
### AI Agents & Now Assist
- Put AI to work on real tasks.
- AI Agents triage and resolve routine work, and AI Agent Orchestrator coordinates them so they hand off cleanly.
- Now Assist helps with the work that still needs a person.
### AI Control Tower
- See and govern every AI in your business from one place.
- AI Control Tower tracks every AI agent, Now Assist skill, and third-party model you run.
- We set up the full governance lifecycle for you, from intake and risk assessment to approval and ongoing monitoring, with clear owners and stewards assigned to each AI asset.
### ServiceNow Otto
- One conversational front door for employees and customers.
- As a Moveworks implementation partner, we help you bring Now Assist, Moveworks, and AI Experience together in Otto so requests get resolved from start to finish.
### Customer Service Management (CSM)
- Get every case to the right person, fast.
- Predictive Intelligence sorts incoming cases, and Advanced Work Assignment routes each one by skill and availability across front, middle, and back office.
### Field Service Management (FSM)
- Fix it on the first visit.
- Schedule Optimization sends the right technician with the right parts, and Predictive Intelligence flags equipment failures before they happen.
### IT Service Management (ITSM)
- Resolve incidents faster.
- Predictive Intelligence routes incidents to the right team automatically, and Now Assist summarizes each case and drafts the resolution notes.
### IT Operations Management (ITOM)
- Catch problems before they become outages, and before the 2am page.
- Predictive AIOps spots unusual behavior early, while Discovery and Service Mapping keep your CMDB accurate as your systems change.
### HR Service Delivery (HRSD)
- Give employees one place to get help.
- Employee Center, HR Virtual Agent, and Now Assist handle routine HR requests around the clock, and guided journeys make onboarding smooth from day one.
### Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM)
- Fund the work that matters most.
- Portfolio Planning and Demand Management give leaders a live view of every investment, and Now Assist for SPM keeps that view up to date.
### Now Platform
- Build the apps your teams need, faster.
- App Engine, Flow Designer, and IntegrationHub cover low-code and no-code building, and Build Agent turns a plain-language description into a governed, ready-to-deploy app.
### Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC / IRM)
- Manage risk in the same place the work happens.
- Policy, risk, and audit workflows connect directly to your IT and business processes, so compliance isn't a separate spreadsheet exercise.
### CMDB & Data Foundations
- Trust your data before you automate on it.
- We build and clean up your CMDB with Discovery, Service Graph Connectors, and the CSDM data model, so AI Agents and workflows run on accurate information.
## Service Offerings

## Frequently Asked Questions
### What ServiceNow services does Exterprise offer?
Exterprise covers ServiceNow from start to finish: advisory, implementation, integration, migration, upgrades and ongoing support. That includes ITSM, ITOM, CSM, HR Service Delivery, Field Service Management, SPM, GRC / IRM, CMDB, Now Platform app development, AI Agents, Now Assist, AI Control Tower and ServiceNow Otto.
### What does ServiceNow Premier Partner status mean for my project?
It means ServiceNow recognizes Exterprise at the Premier level for consulting and implementation. Because we are also a licensed ServiceNow reseller, you can buy licenses, implement and get ongoing support from one team.
### Can Exterprise implement ServiceNow AI Agents and Now Assist?
Yes. Exterprise is certified to implement Now Assist for IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery and Creator, and sets up AI Agents with guardrails and human review points. AI Control Tower keeps every agent visible and accountable.
### Can you improve a ServiceNow instance we already have?
Yes. We assess existing implementations, clean up the CMDB with Discovery and the CSDM data model, handle platform and version upgrades, and build a roadmap showing where Predictive Intelligence, Now Assist and AI Agents add the most value.
### Does Exterprise provide ServiceNow support after go-live?
Yes. Exterprise offers L1 to L4 managed support with 24x7 monitoring across the full ticket lifecycle, plus certified ServiceNow developers, administrators and consultants at onshore, near-shore or offshore rates.

# AI Agents & Now Assist
Agentic and generative AI, deployed on the Now Platform.
Talk to Us
## From Chat to Action
ServiceNow's AI Agents take the next step on their own. They triage a ticket, close out a routine request, or pass it to a person with the full history attached. AI Agent Orchestrator keeps several agents working together so handoffs stay clean. Now Assist adds generative AI to the tools your teams already use, summarizing cases and drafting resolutions in ITSM, HR Service Delivery and Creator.
Exterprise is certified to implement Now Assist for IT Service Management, HR Service Delivery and Creator. We set up AI Agents with the guardrails and human review points your business needs, rather than leaving the defaults in place.

ServiceNow AI Agents take the next step on their own: they triage a ticket, close out a routine request, or pass it to a person with the full history attached. AI Agent Orchestrator coordinates several agents so they hand off work cleanly.

Title: ServiceNow AI Control Tower Implementation | Exterprise
Summary: Govern every AI agent, Now Assist skill and third-party model from one place. Exterprise sets up ServiceNow AI Control Tower, from intake to monitoring.

# AI Control Tower
One place to see, govern, and prove the value of every AI in your business.
Talk to Us
## Know Every AI You Run
Most enterprises can't answer a simple question: how many AI tools are we actually using? Agents in ServiceNow, copilots in Microsoft 365, models your data team built, AI features inside vendor software. Each one carries risk, and few are tracked in one place.
AI Control Tower brings them together. It keeps a live inventory of every AI agent, Now Assist skill, and third-party model, and runs each one through the same governance lifecycle: intake, risk assessment, approval, and ongoing monitoring. Every AI asset has a clear owner, a steward, and a risk and compliance reviewer, so nothing goes live without the right people signing off.
Exterprise has built AI Control Tower governance flows hands-on, from intake questionnaires and impact assessments to role design, and we connect it to the AI Agents and Now Assist work we already deliver.
## How AI Control Tower Works
## 01
### Discover
Build a single inventory of AI assets across ServiceNow and third-party platforms.
02
### Assess
Run intake and impact assessments that score each AI for risk before it's approved.
03
### Govern
Route approvals through defined roles: AI asset owner, AI steward, and risk and compliance analyst.
04
### Monitor
Track performance, usage, and value over time, and flag issues before they become incidents.
## Key Services
## ADVISORY
### AI Governance Design
Define your AI policies, risk tiers, and approval roles, aligned to frameworks like the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the EU AI Act.
DEPLOYMENT
### AI Control Tower Implementation
Configure the AI inventory, intake forms, risk assessments, and approval workflows around how your organization makes decisions.
STAFFING
### Certified AI Specialists
Consultants experienced in AI Control Tower, AI Agents, and Now Assist, available to support your governance team.
MANAGED SERVICES
### Ongoing AI Oversight
Monitor your AI inventory, tune policies as new tools arrive, and keep reporting ready for leadership and auditors.
←AI Agents & Now Assist ServiceNow →ServiceNow Otto

# CMDB & Data Foundations
Trust your data before you automate on it.
Talk to Us
## AI Is Only as Good as the Data Underneath It
Every ServiceNow workflow depends on the Configuration Management Database (CMDB). It tells the platform what systems you have, who owns them, and how they connect. When the CMDB is incomplete or out of date, incidents get routed to the wrong team, change risk goes unnoticed, and AI Agents make decisions based on bad information.
Exterprise builds CMDBs that stay accurate. We use Discovery and Service Graph Connectors to bring data in automatically, the Identification and Reconciliation Engine to prevent duplicates, and ServiceNow's Common Service Data Model (CSDM) to organize it all in a structure the whole platform understands. Our consultants hold the ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist in CMDB (CIS-CMDB).
## CMDB Highlights
### Automated Discovery
Find servers, cloud resources, applications, and network devices automatically with Discovery and Service Mapping.
### Connected Data Sources
Pull in data from tools like Microsoft SCCM, Intune, AWS, and Azure through Service Graph Connectors.
### Clean, Reliable Records
Remove duplicates and keep one trusted record per item with the Identification and Reconciliation Engine.
### A Structure That Scales
Organize services and applications with CSDM, so ITSM, ITOM, GRC, and AI Agents all read from the same map.
### Health You Can Measure
Track completeness, correctness, and compliance with the CMDB Health Dashboard.
## Key Services
## ADVISORY
### CMDB Health Assessment
Review your current CMDB against CSDM best practices and build a prioritized plan to fix gaps.
DEPLOYMENT
### CMDB Build-Out and Cleanup
Configure Discovery, MID Servers, Service Mapping, and Service Graph Connectors, and clean up existing data.
STAFFING
### CIS-CMDB Certified Consultants

# Field Service Management
For faster response time and prevention of issues, powered by Schedule Optimization and AI Agents.
Talk to Us
## Modernized Field Service Management
The ServiceNow Field Service Management application helps organizations manage work tasks performed on assets in the field. It matches tasks to agents based on skills, location, technician availability, and parts/inventory. Agents can record details on assigned tasks like completion status, travel time to jobs, and add pictures and time spent.
Schedule Optimization, ServiceNow's AI scheduling engine, keeps re-matching the right technician as plans change: a cancellation, a late part, a more urgent job. Its Explainability view shows dispatchers why each assignment was made, so nobody has to guess about routes and timing.
Two AI Agents help here. The Shift Management AI Agent fills open shifts by matching available technicians on skills, location and constraints. The Create Work Order AI Agent turns a technician's field notes and photos into a complete work order in seconds, with no retyping.
## FSM Highlights
Our team makes sure your field service team:
### Solves Customer Issues on the First Visit
- Schedule Optimization automatically assigns the most qualified technician based on skills, location, availability, and parts on hand
- With Territory Planning and Capacity & Reservations making sure the right crew is available before the job gets booked, not after
### Maximizes Uptime
Predictive Intelligence analyzes asset data, IoT sensor readings, and usage patterns to flag likely failures before they happen, automatically triggering preventive maintenance work orders instead of waiting on a breakdown.
### Improves Efficiency
- The Now Assist mobile copilot is built into the FSM app and works offline. It gives technicians on-site guidance, summaries and notes, with remote video and AR support when a job needs another expert.
- Create and meet SLAs, optimize schedules, and keep workers safe, with Performance Analytics tracking it all.
## Top Challenges
Faced by field service technicians, and how the platform handles each one today.
01
### Pre-Visit Review of Service/Asset History
Asset history, warranty status and past service records show up on the work order, so nobody digs through other systems before dispatch.
02
### Access to Service Manuals
Manuals and documentation linked directly to the asset record, available offline in the FSM mobile app.
03
### Access to Knowledge Base
Searchable offline, with Now Assist for Field Service surfacing similar past resolutions automatically.
04
### Visibility of Parts & Inventory
Real-time stock visibility across ERP-connected inventory via IntegrationHub, so a technician never commits to a fix without the part in hand.
05
### Training Videos
Attached directly to task types, with Now Assist for Field Service's mobile copilot walking newer technicians through unfamiliar jobs step by step.

# IT Operations Management
Right-size and optimize your IT investments with Predictive AIOps.
Talk to Us
## Evolve to the Next Stage in ITSM
IT Operations Management (ITOM) covers everything an IT department runs: applications, storage, networking, hardware and software. The goal is to keep all of it healthy on every server and node. Predictive AIOps goes a step further, spotting anomalies and flagging service issues before they cause an outage.
## ITOM and ITSM: A Dynamic Duo
ITOM is about how IT runs its own systems. ITSM is about how IT delivers services to users. The two overlap more every year: an anomaly that Predictive AIOps catches in ITOM often becomes the incident that Predictive Intelligence sorts and routes in ITSM.
ServiceNow ITOM brings Event Management, Metric Intelligence and Health Log Analytics together, and it builds on the ServiceNow ITSM you already have.
We make sure your IT team can see every part of the infrastructure. Discovery and CMDB mapping keep configuration data accurate, and AI Control Tower keeps track of the AI Agents and automations that act on it.

# Now Platform
Low-code, no-code and now plain-language app building with Build Agent, all on ServiceNow.
Talk to Us
## Cross-Enterprise, Digital Workflows. Now.
The Now Platform, anchored by App Engine, is a rapid application modeling and development engine that lets platform users quickly model, build, integrate, and deploy custom applications within ServiceNow.
With ready-made service templates, reusable Flow Designer actions and IntegrationHub spokes, it grows your ServiceNow services as the business changes, without replacing applications each time.
Build Agent goes further. Teams describe an app in plain language and get a governed starting point they can deploy, while RaptorDB keeps the data behind it fast as it grows.
## Who Is It for?
If your organization already uses ServiceNow (ITSM, ITOM, or CSM), it's an ideal time to build on the Now Platform. Exterprise's team of experts will:
01
### Design
Use App Engine Studio to shape user and process flows and map them to ServiceNow components and modules, visually and without writing boilerplate code.
02
### Develop & Integrate
Flow Designer automates the process logic and IntegrationHub connects the new app to your other business systems, so there's no separate integration project.
03
### Deploy
Deploy the custom app in minutes inside ServiceNow, with AI Control Tower governance in place from day one.

# ServiceNow Otto
Now Assist, Moveworks and AI Experience in one assistant that gets the request done instead of only answering it.
Talk to Us
Just launched: ServiceNow announced Otto at Knowledge 2026, and it's rolling out across the platform through the rest of the year, starting with ServiceNow EmployeeWorks and AI Control Tower. This page covers what ServiceNow has shared publicly so far. We're following the rollout as it reaches more products.
## One Place to Ask, Work That Gets Done
Most enterprises already have AI scattered across their tools: a copilot in the ticketing system, a chatbot on the intranet, a summarizer in the CRM. None of them talk to each other or remember the last conversation. ServiceNow Otto is ServiceNow's answer. It's a single conversational layer that brings together Moveworks, which ServiceNow acquired in 2025, with Now Assist and the AI Experience interface.
Otto doesn't replace the workflows underneath. It sits on top of the ServiceNow platform, approval chains, and permissions you already have, and AI Control Tower logs and explains every action it takes.
Exterprise already works with every piece Otto brings together. We're a Moveworks implementation partner, we hold Now Assist certifications for ITSM, HR Service Delivery, and Creator, and we've implemented AI Agent Orchestrator and AI Control Tower hands-on. That puts us in a strong position to help you prepare for Otto as it reaches more of the platform.
3Now Assist certifications held (ITSM, HRSD, Creator), the base Otto builds onPremierPartner, Consulting & Implementation4.5/5Customer satisfaction scoreCertifiedServiceNow-accredited professionals on staff
## How Otto Reaches People
Four channels, all governed the same way through AI Control Tower.
CONVERSATIONAL AI
### Ask in Plain Language
Employees and customers submit requests conversationally, and Otto routes and resolves them across departments without switching tools.
ENTERPRISE SEARCH
### One Search, Every Source
Searches documents, wikis, databases and connected systems like SharePoint, with results based on the person's role and location.
AI VOICE AGENTS
### No Menu Trees, No Hold Queues
Handles requests by voice, in several languages, on both employee and customer support lines.
AI DATA EXPLORER
### Ask the Data Directly
Business users query enterprise data in plain language and get the analysis back immediately, without filing a request to the analytics team.
